```{r, warning=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(broom)
library(patchwork)
library(plotly)
```


# Process data
```{r}
data_full <- data.frame()

for(r in c(0:9)){
  spikes <- read.csv(paste0("data/wmat1/log_spikes_48000_sim", r, ".csv"))
  labels <- read.csv(paste0("data/wmat1/log_labels_48000_sim", r, ".csv"))
  
  data <- cbind(spikes, labels) %>%
    mutate(time = row_number(),
           sim = r)
  
  data_full <- rbind(data_full, data)
}
```

```{r}
data_full$label <- case_when(
  data_full$label=="man_s" ~ "man",
  data_full$label=="dog_s" ~ "dog",
  TRUE ~ data_full$label
)

data_full$label <- case_when(
  data_full$label=="walks_v" & lag(data_full$label)=="man" ~ "man_walks",
  data_full$label=="walks_v" & lag(data_full$label)=="dog" ~ "dog_walks",
  data_full$label=="bites_v" & lag(data_full$label)=="man" ~ "man_bites",
  data_full$label=="bites_v" & lag(data_full$label)=="dog" ~ "dog_bites",
  TRUE ~ data_full$label
)

data_full$label <- case_when(
  data_full$label=="man_o" & lag(data_full$label)=="man_walks" ~ "man_walks_man",
  data_full$label=="man_o" & lag(data_full$label)=="dog_walks" ~ "dog_walks_man",
  data_full$label=="man_o" & lag(data_full$label)=="man_bites" ~ "man_bites_man",
  data_full$label=="man_o" & lag(data_full$label)=="dog_bites" ~ "dog_bites_man",
  data_full$label=="dog_o" & lag(data_full$label)=="man_walks" ~ "man_walks_dog",
  data_full$label=="dog_o" & lag(data_full$label)=="dog_walks" ~ "dog_walks_dog",
  data_full$label=="dog_o" & lag(data_full$label)=="man_bites" ~ "man_bites_dog",
  data_full$label=="dog_o" & lag(data_full$label)=="dog_bites" ~ "dog_bites_dog",
  TRUE ~ data_full$label
)

data_full_filtered <- data_full %>%
  filter(time > 3000) # remove burn-in

token_list <- unique(data_full_filtered$label)
subject_list <- c("man", "dog")
verb_list <- c("man_walks", "dog_walks", "man_bites", "dog_bites")
object_list <- c("man_walks_man", "dog_walks_man", "man_bites_man", "dog_bites_man", "man_walks_dog", "dog_walks_dog", "man_bites_dog", "dog_bites_dog")
buffer_list <- c("_a", "_b", "_c")
node_id <- colnames(data_full[,1:100])
sim_id <- c(0:9)
```


# Avg embeddings
```{r}
n_windows=25

avg_embeddings <- data_full_filtered %>%
  filter(label %in% token_list) %>%
  mutate(window = cut(time, breaks = seq(min(time, na.rm = TRUE), max(time, na.rm = TRUE),
                                         length.out = n_windows + 1), include.lowest = TRUE, labels = FALSE)) %>%
  group_by(window, label, sim) %>%
  summarise(n_obs = n(), across(all_of(node_id), ~ mean(.x)), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = all_of(node_id), names_to = "node", values_to = "value") %>%
  mutate(label = factor(label, levels = c(subject_list, verb_list, object_list, buffer_list)),
         class = factor(case_when(label %in% subject_list ~ "subject",
                                  label %in% verb_list ~ "verb",
                                  label %in% object_list ~ "object",
                                  T ~ "buffer"),
                        levels = c("subject", "verb", "object", "buffer")))

avg_embeddings %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=n_obs)) +
    facet_wrap(~label) +
    geom_histogram()
```


# Token-level drift
```{r}
token_combs <- expand.grid(f1=token_list, f2=sim_id)

token_similarity <- do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_len(nrow(token_combs)), function(row){
  subset <- avg_embeddings %>%
    filter(label==token_combs[row,1], sim==token_combs[row,2]) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = node, values_from = value)
  
  windows <- subset$window
  x <- as.matrix(subset %>% ungroup() %>% select(!c(window,label,sim,n_obs,class)))
  n <- nrow(x)
 
  pairs <- combn(n,2)
  r <- apply(pairs, 2, function(p) {cor(x[p[1], ], x[p[2], ], method = "pearson")})

  data.frame(class=unique(subset$class),
             label=token_combs[row,1],
             sim=token_combs[row,2],
             window1=pairs[1,],
             window2=pairs[2,],
             cor=r)
}))
```

```{r}
token_similarity %>%
  group_by(label, window1, window2) %>%
  summarise(m = mean(cor), .groups ="drop") %>%
  mutate(label = factor(label, levels = c(subject_list, verb_list, object_list, buffer_list))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=window1, y=window2, fill=m)) +
    facet_wrap(~label) +
    geom_tile() +
    scale_fill_viridis_c(guide = guide_colorbar(barheight = unit(10, "cm"), barwidth = unit(1, "cm"))) +
    labs(x = "time window", y = "time window", fill = "r") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(panel.grid = element_blank(),
          axis.title = element_text(size=28),
          axis.text = element_text(size=26),
          strip.text = element_text(size=28),
          legend.title = element_text(size=28),
          legend.text = element_text(size=26))

token_similarity %>%
  group_by(label, window1, window2) %>%
  reframe(class = class, cor = mean(cor)) %>%
  mutate(diag = window2 - window1) %>%
  filter(diag > 0) %>%
  group_by(diag, label) %>%
  reframe(class=class, m = mean(cor), se = sd(cor)/sqrt(n())) %>%
  mutate(label = factor(label, levels = c(subject_list, verb_list, object_list, buffer_list)),
         class = factor(class, levels = c("subject", "verb", "object", "buffer"))) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=diag, y=m, group=label, color=label, fill=label)) +
    facet_wrap(~class) +
    geom_line() +
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin=m-se, ymax=m+se), alpha=0.2, linetype=0) +
    labs(x = "lag", y = "r") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(axis.title = element_text(size=28),
          axis.text = element_text(size=26),
          strip.text = element_text(size=28),
          legend.title = element_blank(),
          legend.text = element_text(size=26),
          legend.key.spacing.y = unit(1, "cm")) +
    guides(color = guide_legend(ncol = 2), fill = guide_legend(ncol = 2))
```

```{r}
token_similarity %>%
  group_by(label, window1, window2) %>%
  summarise(cor = mean(cor), .groups ="drop") %>%
  mutate(diag = window2 - window1) %>%
  filter(diag > 0) %>%
  group_by(diag, label) %>%
  summarise(m = mean(cor), se = sd(cor)/sqrt(n()), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(label = factor(label, levels = c(subject_list, verb_list, object_list, buffer_list))) %>%
  group_by(label) %>%
  do(tidy(lm(m ~ diag, data = .))) %>%
  filter(term == "diag") %>%
  select(label, b = estimate, se = std.error) %>%
  print()
```


## Cross-token drift
```{r}
cross_combs <- combn(token_list, 2, simplify = FALSE)

crosstoken_similarity <- do.call(rbind, lapply(cross_combs, function(pair) {

  do.call(rbind, lapply(sim_id, function(s) {

    token1 <- avg_embeddings %>%
      filter(label == pair[1], sim == s) %>%
      pivot_wider(names_from = node, values_from = value) %>%
      arrange(window)

    token2 <- avg_embeddings %>%
      filter(label == pair[2], sim == s) %>%
      pivot_wider(names_from = node, values_from = value) %>%
      arrange(window)

    x <- as.matrix(token1 %>% ungroup %>% select(!c(window, label, sim, n_obs, class)))

    y <- as.matrix(token2 %>% ungroup %>% select(!c(window, label, sim, n_obs, class)))

    # vectorized correlation
    x_centered <- x - rowMeans(x)
    y_centered <- y - rowMeans(y)
    
    x_norm <- x_centered / sqrt(rowSums(x_centered^2))
    y_norm <- y_centered / sqrt(rowSums(y_centered^2))
    
    pearson <- x_norm %*% t(y_norm)

    # store
    expand.grid(window1 = token1$window, window2 = token2$window) %>%
      mutate(label1 = pair[1], label2 = pair[2], sim = s, cor = as.vector(pearson), pair = paste(pair, collapse = "x"))
 }))
}))
```

# Relation-level stability
```{r}
geometry_over_time <- do.call(rbind, lapply(sim_id, function(s) {

  do.call(rbind, lapply(unique(avg_embeddings$window), function(w) {

    subset <- avg_embeddings %>%
      filter(sim == s, window == w) %>%
      pivot_wider(names_from = node, values_from = value) %>%
      arrange(match(label, token_list))

    x <- as.matrix(subset %>% ungroup() %>% select(!c(window, label, sim, n_obs, class)))

    # vectorized cosine similarity
    x_norm <- x / sqrt(rowSums(x^2))
    cos <- x_norm %*% t(x_norm)

    # store
    expand.grid(label1 = subset$label, label2 = subset$label) %>%
      mutate(sim = s, window = w, cos = as.vector(cos))
  }))
}))
```

```{r}
geometry_over_time %>%
  group_by(label1, label2, window) %>%
  summarise(m = mean(cos), .groups = "drop") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=label1, y=label2, fill=m)) +
    facet_wrap(~window) +
    geom_tile() +
    scale_fill_viridis_c(guide = guide_colorbar(barheight = unit(10, "cm"), barwidth = unit(1, "cm"))) +
    labs(x = "token", y = "token", fill = expression(S[cos])) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(panel.grid = element_blank(),
          axis.title = element_text(size=28),
          axis.text = element_blank(),
          strip.text = element_text(size=28),
          legend.title = element_text(size=28),
          legend.text = element_text(size=26))
```

```{r}
geometry_similarity <- geometry_over_time %>%
  mutate(label1 = as.character(label1), label2 = as.character(label2)) %>%
  filter(label1 < label2) %>% # keep upper triangle
  pivot_wider(names_from = window, values_from = cos) %>%
  group_by(sim) %>%
  summarise(cormat = list(cor(as.matrix(pick(-any_of(c("label1", "label2", "sim")))),
                              method = "pearson", use = "pairwise.complete.obs")),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(cormat = map(cormat, ~ as.data.frame(.x) %>%
                        tibble::rownames_to_column("window1") %>%
                        pivot_longer(cols = !window1, names_to = "window2", values_to = "cor"))) %>%
  unnest(cormat) %>%
  mutate(window1 = as.numeric(window1), window2 = as.numeric(window2))
```

```{r}
geometry_similarity %>%
  group_by(window1, window2) %>%
  summarise(m = mean(cor), .groups = "drop") %>%
  ggplot(aes(window1, window2, fill = m)) +
    geom_tile() +
    scale_fill_viridis_c(guide = guide_colorbar(barheight = unit(10, "cm"), barwidth = unit(1, "cm"))) +
    labs(x = "time window", y = "time window", fill = "r") +

          axis.text = element_text(size=26),

          legend.title = element_text(size=28),
          legend.text = element_text(size=26))
```

## Simulations permuted
```{r}
geometry_data <- geometry_over_time %>%
  mutate(label1 = as.character(label1), label2 = as.character(label2)) %>%
  filter(label1 < label2) # keep upper triangle

set.seed(123)
n_perm <- 100
windows <- sort(unique(geometry_data$window))
sims <- sort(unique(geometry_data$sim))

geometry_sims_permuted <- map_dfr(seq_len(n_perm), function(p) {

  # shuffle simulation identities within each window
  permuted_data <- map_dfr(windows, function(w) {
    window_data <- geometry_data %>%
      filter(window == w)

    sim_permutation <- tibble(sim = sims, sim_perm = sample(sims))

    window_data %>%
      left_join(sim_permutation, by = "sim") %>%
      mutate(sim = sim_perm) %>%
      select(!sim_perm)
  })

  # calculate within-permuted-simulation correlations
  permuted_data %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = window, values_from = cos) %>%
    group_by(sim) %>%
    summarise(cormat = list(cor(as.matrix(pick(-any_of(c("label1", "label2", "sim")))),
                                method = "pearson", use = "pairwise.complete.obs")),
              .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(cormat = map(cormat, ~ as.data.frame(.x) %>%
                          tibble::rownames_to_column("window1") %>%
                          pivot_longer(cols = !window1, names_to = "window2", values_to = "cor"))) %>%
    unnest(cormat) %>%
    mutate(window1 = as.numeric(window1), window2 = as.numeric(window2), permutation = p)
})
```

```{r}
geometry_sims_permuted %>%
  group_by(window1, window2) %>%
  summarise(m = mean(cor), .groups = "drop") %>%
  ggplot(aes(window1, window2, fill = m)) +
    geom_tile() +
    scale_fill_viridis_c(guide = guide_colorbar(barheight = unit(10, "cm"), barwidth = unit(1, "cm"))) +
    labs(x = "time window", y = "time window", fill = "r") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(axis.title = element_text(size=28),
          axis.text = element_text(size=26),
          strip.text = element_text(size=28),
          legend.title = element_text(size=28),
          legend.text = element_text(size=26))
```


## Tokens permuted
```{r}
geometry_data <- geometry_over_time %>%
  mutate(label1 = as.character(label1), label2 = as.character(label2)) %>%
  filter(label1 < label2) # keep upper triangle

set.seed(123)
n_perm <- 100
windows <- sort(unique(geometry_data$window))
sims <- sort(unique(geometry_data$sim))

geometry_tokens_permuted <- map_dfr(seq_len(n_perm), function(p) {
  
  # shuffle token identities within each window
  permuted_data <- map_dfr(sims, function(s) {
    map_dfr(windows, function(w) {
      window_data <- geometry_data %>%
        filter(sim == s, window == w)

      token_permutation <- tibble(label = token_list, label_perm = sample(token_list))

      window_data %>%
        left_join(token_permutation %>% rename(label1 = label, label1_perm = label_perm), by = "label1") %>%
        left_join(token_permutation %>% rename(label2 = label, label2_perm = label_perm), by = "label2") %>%
        mutate(label1 = label1_perm, label2 = label2_perm) %>% 
        select(!c(label1_perm, label2_perm)) %>%
        mutate(label_temp = pmin(label1, label2), label2 = pmax(label1, label2), label1 = label_temp) %>%
        select(!label_temp)
    })
  })

  # calculate within-simulation token-permuted correlations
  permuted_data %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = window, values_from = cos) %>%
    group_by(sim) %>%
    summarise(cormat = list(cor(as.matrix(pick(-any_of(c("label1", "label2", "sim")))),
                                method = "pearson", use = "pairwise.complete.obs")),
              .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(cormat = map(cormat, ~ as.data.frame(.x) %>%
                          tibble::rownames_to_column("window1") %>%
                          pivot_longer(cols = !window1, names_to = "window2", values_to = "cor"))) %>%
    unnest(cormat) %>%
    mutate(window1 = as.numeric(window1), window2 = as.numeric(window2), permutation = p)
})
```

```{r}
geometry_tokens_permuted %>%
  group_by(window1, window2) %>%
  summarise(m = mean(cor), .groups = "drop") %>%
  ggplot(aes(window1, window2, fill = m)) +
    geom_tile() +
    scale_fill_viridis_c(guide = guide_colorbar(barheight = unit(10, "cm"), barwidth = unit(1, "cm"))) +
    labs(x = "time window", y = "time window", fill = "r") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(axis.title = element_text(size=28),
          axis.text = element_text(size=26),
          strip.text = element_text(size=28),
          legend.title = element_text(size=28),
          legend.text = element_text(size=26))
```


## Cross-run stability
```{r}
crossgeometry_over_time <- do.call(rbind, lapply(sim_id, function(s) {

  s2 <- (s + 1) %% length(sim_id)

  do.call(rbind, lapply(unique(avg_embeddings$window), function(w) {

    subset1 <- avg_embeddings %>%
      filter(sim == s, window == w) %>%
      pivot_wider(names_from = node, values_from = value) %>%
      arrange(match(label, token_list))

    subset2 <- avg_embeddings %>%
      filter(sim == s2, window == w) %>%
      pivot_wider(names_from = node, values_from = value) %>%
      arrange(match(label, token_list))

    x <- as.matrix(subset1 %>% ungroup() %>% select(!c("window", "label", "sim", "n_obs", "class")))
    y <- as.matrix(subset2 %>% ungroup() %>% select(!c("window", "label", "sim", "n_obs", "class")))

    # vectorized cosine similarity
    x_norm <- x / sqrt(rowSums(x^2))
    y_norm <- y / sqrt(rowSums(y^2))

    cos <- x_norm %*% t(y_norm)

    # store
    expand.grid(label1 = subset1$label, label2 = subset2$label) %>%
      mutate(sim1 = s, sim2 = s2, window = w, cos = as.vector(cos))
  }))
}))
```

```{r}
crossgeometry_over_time %>%
  group_by(label1, label2, window) %>%
  summarise(m = mean(cos), .groups = "drop") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=label1, y=label2, fill=m)) +
    facet_wrap(~window) +
    geom_tile() +
    scale_fill_viridis_c(guide = guide_colorbar(barheight = unit(10, "cm"), barwidth = unit(1, "cm"))) +
    labs(x = "token", y = "token", fill = expression(S[cos])) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(panel.grid = element_blank(),
          axis.title = element_text(size=28),
          axis.text = element_blank(),
          strip.text = element_text(size=28),
          legend.title = element_text(size=28),
          legend.text = element_text(size=26))
```

                              method = "pearson", use = "pairwise.complete.obs")),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(cormat = map(cormat, ~ as.data.frame(.x) %>%

  unnest(cormat) %>%
  mutate(window1 = as.numeric(window1), window2 = as.numeric(window2))

# Manuscript figures

```{r}
embedding_df <- token_similarity %>%
  group_by(window1, window2) %>%
  summarise(cor = mean(cor), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(diag = window2 - window1) %>%
  filter(diag > 0) %>%
  group_by(diag) %>%
  summarise(m = mean(cor), se = sd(cor)/sqrt(n()), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(type = "embeddings")

geometry_df <- geometry_similarity %>%
  group_by(window1, window2) %>%
  summarise(cor = mean(cor), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(diag = window2 - window1) %>%
  filter(diag > 0) %>%
  group_by(diag) %>%
  summarise(m = mean(cor), se = sd(cor)/sqrt(n())) %>%
  mutate(type = "autoRSM")

crossgeometry_df <- crossgeometry_similarity %>%
  group_by(window1, window2) %>%
  summarise(cor = mean(cor), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(diag = window2 - window1) %>%
  filter(diag > 0) %>%
  group_by(diag) %>%
  summarise(m = mean(cor), se = sd(cor)/sqrt(n())) %>%
  mutate(type = "crossRSM")

combined_df <- bind_rows(list(embedding_df, geometry_df, crossgeometry_df)) %>%
  mutate(type = factor(type, levels = c("embeddings", "autoRSM", "crossRSM")))
```


## Embedding heatmap

```{r}
token_similarity %>%
  group_by(label, window1, window2) %>%
  summarise(cor = mean(cor), .groups ="drop") %>%
  group_by(window1, window2) %>%
  summarise(m = mean(cor), .groups = "drop") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=window1, y=window2, fill=m)) +
    geom_tile() +
    scale_fill_viridis_c(guide = guide_colorbar(barheight = unit(10, "cm"), barwidth = unit(1, "cm"))) +
    labs(x = "time window", y = "time window", fill = "Pearson's r") +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(panel.grid = element_blank(),
          axis.title = element_text(size=28),
          axis.text = element_text(size=26),
          strip.text = element_text(size=28),
          legend.title = element_text(size=28),
          legend.text = element_text(size=26),
          plot.margin = margin(t = 20, r = 20, b = 20, l = 20, unit = "pt"))

# ggsave("figures/manuscript/lang_drift_heatmap.png", bg="white", width=10, height=8)
```


## RSM heatmap
```{r}
bind_rows(
  geometry_over_time %>%
    group_by(label1, label2, window) %>%
    summarise(m = mean(cos), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(cond="autoRSM"),
  crossgeometry_over_time %>%
    group_by(label1, label2, window) %>%
    summarise(m = mean(cos), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(cond="crossRSM")
) %>%
  mutate(cond = factor(cond, levels = c("autoRSM", "crossRSM")),
         label1 = factor(label1),
         label2 = factor(label2)) %>%
  group_by(cond, window) %>%
  mutate(row = as.numeric(label1), col = as.numeric(label2)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter((cond == "autoRSM" & row < col) | (cond == "crossRSM" & row > col),
         window %in% c(1,25)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = label1, y = label2, fill = m)) +
    facet_wrap(~window) +
    geom_tile() +
    scale_fill_viridis_c(limits = c(0.5, 0.8), oob = scales::squish,
                         guide = guide_colorbar(barheight = unit(10, "cm"), barwidth = unit(1, "cm"))) +
    labs(x = "embedding", y = "embedding", fill = expression(S[cos])) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(panel.grid = element_blank(),
          axis.title = element_text(size = 28),
          axis.text = element_blank(),
          strip.text = element_text(size = 28),
          legend.title = element_text(size = 28, margin = margin(b = 15)),
          legend.text = element_text(size = 26))

# ggsave("figures/manuscript/lang_geometry_heatmap.png", bg="white", width=15, height=8)
```

# PCA

```{r}
pca <- avg_embeddings %>%
  filter(sim==2) %>%
  select(!c(n_obs, sim)) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = node, values_from = value) %>%
  group_by(class) %>%
  group_modify(~ {
    metadata <- .x %>%
      select(window, label)

    features <- .x %>%
      select(all_of(node_id))

    pca_fit <- prcomp(features, center = T, scale. = T)
    variance <- 100 * pca_fit$sdev^2 / sum(pca_fit$sdev^2)

    bind_cols(metadata, as.data.frame(pca_fit$x[, 1:3]) %>% set_names(c("PC1", "PC2", "PC3"))) %>%
      mutate(var_PC1 = variance[1], var_PC2 = variance[2], var_PC3 = variance[3])}) %>%
  ungroup()
```

```{r}
pca %>%
  arrange(window) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=PC1, y=PC2, color=window)) +
    facet_wrap(~class) +
    geom_point() +
    geom_path() +
    theme_minimal()
```


```{r}
pcaplot_df <- pca %>%
  filter(class == "subject", window %in% seq(1, 25, 3)) %>%
  mutate(window = as.numeric(as.character(window))) %>%
  arrange(label, window)

last_points <- pcaplot_df %>%
  group_by(label) %>%
  filter(window == min(window)) %>%
  ungroup()

p <- plot_ly(
  data = pcaplot_df,
  x = ~PC1,
  y = ~PC2,
  z = ~PC3,
  color = ~window,
  colors = grDevices::hcl.colors(50, palette = "inferno")[1:45],
  type = "scatter3d",
  mode = "markers+lines",
  split = ~label,
  showlegend = F,
  line = list(width = 10),
  marker = list(size = 10)
  ) %>%
  layout(
  scene = list(
    aspectmode = "cube",
    xaxis = list(title = "PC1", titlefont=list(size=50), tick = "", showticklabels = FALSE, gridcolor="black", gridwidth=3),
    yaxis = list(title = "PC2", titlefont=list(size=50), tick = "", showticklabels = FALSE, gridcolor="black", gridwidth=3),
    zaxis = list(title = "PC3", titlefont=list(size=50), tick = "", showticklabels = FALSE, gridcolor="black", gridwidth=3)
  )
)

p <- plotly_build(p)

for (i in seq_along(p$x$data)) {
  p$x$data[[i]]$marker$showscale <- FALSE
}

p <- p %>%
  add_trace(
    data = last_points,
    x = ~PC1,
    y = ~PC2,
    z = ~PC3,
    type = "scatter3d",
    mode = "text",
    text = ~label,
    textposition = "bottom right",
    textfont = list(
      size = 50,
      color = "red"
    ),
    showlegend = FALSE,
    inherit = FALSE
  )

p
```
